answer_2.quote: For spatial grounding, we report two exact match (EM) scores, up to the state-level and city-level, respectively. For temporal grounding, we report the accuracy for judging whether a quantity is an overall quantity ending on DCT ("Binary" in Table ), and two EM scores for cases where the gold start time is a specific date ("S-N" for "Start-Nontrivial") and where the end time is not DCT ("E-N" for "End-Nontrivial").
